evidence.result: 2.1.197 (Claude Code); Anthropic subscription quota exhausted for native Anthropic-backed use, but the CLI driver itself is present

notes: Do not dispatch native Anthropic-backed Claude work while the subscription quota constraint is active.
cc-shim is still eligible when it is explicitly bound to a third-party Anthropic-compatible provider token such as MiniMax or GLM; that provider quota is separate from Anthropic subscription quota.
Existing Claude Code plugin behavior must remain unchanged unless a phase explicitly touches Claude packaging.
